title: Boosting Earth System Model Outputs And Saving PetaBytes in Their Storage Using Exascale Climate Emulators
problem: Earth System Model simulations generate massive high-resolution data requiring exascale computational resources and petabyte-scale storage. The challenge is to develop efficient climate emulators that maintain fidelity while reducing both computational and storage requirements.
motivation: Accurate high-resolution climate simulations are critical for climate science and policy decisions, but current approaches incur prohibitive computational and storage costs.
method: The approach uses spherical harmonic transform to stochastically model spatio-temporal variations in climate data, achieving ultra-high spatial resolution (0.034°). Linear solver software is extended to mixed-precision arithmetic on GPUs, adapting precision levels to different correlation strengths. The PaRESEC runtime system optimizes parallel matrix operations, and BLAS3-rich code is tuned for multiple GPU architectures.
key_novelty: Combining spherical harmonic transform with stochastic modeling and mixed-precision GPU-accelerated linear solvers to create a scalable climate emulator achieving ultra-high spatial resolution while dramatically reducing storage footprint.
contributions: Design and implementation of exascale climate emulator using spherical harmonic transform for stochastic spatio-temporal climate data modeling
Extension of linear solver software to mixed-precision arithmetic on GPUs, adapting precision to correlation strengths
Optimization of BLAS3-rich code for multiple GPU generations achieving near-exascale throughput (0.976 EFlop/s on Frontier)
Demonstration of climate emulation trained on billions of data points from multi-decade global simulations

metrics.speedup: 0.976 EFlop/s on Frontier (36,100 MI250X GPUs), 0.739 EFlop/s on Alps, 0.243 EFlop/s on Leonardo, 0.375 EFlop/s on Summit

limitations: Fidelity trade-offs compared to full Earth System Model simulations and scalability limits beyond tested system sizes not discussed.
